title: Setup fixes
changes: Setting up 911 and the CAD system from /setup and /config now works - those options used to fail with "This interaction failed"
AI Dispatch: the traffic stop channel option now works instead of showing an error
AI Dispatch: added a Set LEO Roles step - without it the bot listened to everyone in the patrol channel instead of just your officers
The blacklist setup menu now closes properly when you pick Done
Loan and business banking commands now work for staff members who are not full administrators
Removed a Set Priority Role option that never did anything
Priority Tracker now correctly requires Premium, as it was always meant to
